message: 心のフィルム

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, to think it was chemical substances.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When logic goes too far, it turns absurd, man.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I just hope you keep thinking that way... *sigh*」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Nothing, I just remembered what happened on Kirara today.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a tough excuse, Soba.」

name: Synn
message: 「Was it dark enough to make you sigh? Didn't she get into the music college!? Did another incident happen!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're way too airheaded, Synn-sama.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. She got in on a unanimous recommendation from the professors, her mom was thrilled, and everyone at the boarding house threw a huge party!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When she played the oboe at the celebration, her missing older brother showed up, drawn in by the music. They finally reunited.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's nothing to sigh about there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thing is, her mom became convinced that her daughter got into music college thanks to the power of Lord Cthugha... and that very night, she renounced the world to become a nun.」

name: Synn
message: 「What!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, President, look! We've gotten this many open-entry applications!」

name: Synn
message: 「What!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, the very first ones to apply were the Sweets Club, so keep that in mind.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's all thanks to how well KiraFes went.」

name: Synn
message: 「We've got to make the most of this excitement.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm already thinking that far ahead. Even the choir is brainstorming all sorts of ideas to get more people to participate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess we can't let ourselves fall behind either!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh. Everyone is so fired up! Azel! Let's do something too!」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Umm... I know! How about an exhibition of photos showing what the Student Council is like! Let's use that to build camaraderie!」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Synn
message: 「...A photo exhibition, huh? Sounds good to me.」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you're planning to take pictures of every student in the academy, aren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I have no such intention.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've been taking photos of one class a day lately, haven't you?」
I operated my laptop and pulled up the thumbnails of the digital camera data Azel had taken over the past few days. Everyone gathered around.

name: Ria
message: 「It's true. Nice catch, Synn-kun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks like almost everyone in our class is in these.」

name: Misa
message: 「She's been photographing them starting from Year 1 Class A. How methodical.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's a coincidence!」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, the biggest problem will be Tennouji-san.」

name: Azel
message: 「Tennouji?」

name: Ria
message: 「She's in all kinds of clubs at once--even more elusive than my big sister.」

name: Azel
message: 「She'd still be in her classroom before and after lessons, wouldn't she?」

name: Misa
message: 「She barely even shows up to class. Shio was furious about it.」

name: Azel
message: 「That sounds tough...」

name: Azel
message: 「N-No, it's not like I'm trying to photograph everyone anyway.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aze-ko, that's what happens when you leave all the data transfers to Synn-sama.」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so... you really pay attention, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「I dunno, I just really like the photos Azel takes.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I'm just taking whatever pictures I want, however I want.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's totally fine. We'll go ahead and pick out which ones to exhibit ourselves.」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What did you say!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I'm telling you not to worry about it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave it to me! I'll boldly pick out all the funny photos!」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'd have a problem with you picking out the poorly taken ones on your own.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That's mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you pick them, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's only because that's better than having them chosen without my say.」
And so, while we were doing things like Spirit Arts training along the way.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew. Today was another fulfilling day.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Time sure flies when you're having fun, doesn't it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hearing you put it like that, Lolotte, makes it sound like we're just messing around.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Let's go home, let's go home!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. What's wrong with Azel?」
Azel, who was supposed to be picking out photos even while grumbling about it, was slumped face-down on the desk.

name: Ria
message: 「Azel, are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Nothing but subpar shots.」
It seems she's taking emotional damage from the photos she took herself.
They don't look bad to me, though I guess the one who took them has her own standards.

name: Synn
message: 「There are still plenty of days left until the Holy Night Festival, so you can take your time choosing.」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh... I'm drowning in self-loathing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. You're going to let me see your Leica today, right?」
Azel revived.

name: Synn
message: 「We don't have patrol today, so I'll go with you to the library.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since it'll probably get late, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I don't really mind either way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, well, you've run into a Demon plenty of times already, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「They haven't done anything to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Up until now, sure. You never know what might happen from here on out, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Do whatever you want.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're the same as ever, Azel-san. If you can't gracefully accept other people's goodwill, you'll never become popular like me.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no intention of becoming popular.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're being especially cold to me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...She's not the same as ever. She would've turned it down before.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's how it is--sorry, Nanaka.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? Why are you glaring at me like that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing!」

name: Synn
message: 「? Well, as long as it's nothing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're a sinful man, Synn-sama.」

name: Azel
message: 「So this is a Leica!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. It's a model called the Leica M3.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's certainly an older model... yet... there's something nice about this... When I press here... Ho. So this is the shutter button... It's lighter than I expected.」
Without even touching the black tea served to her, Azel fiddles around with the vintage camera.
She's just like a kid who's been given a toy she's wanted forever.

name: Azel
message: 「It really is different from a digital camera.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Since it's mechanical, it can be quite a hassle in various ways.」

name: Azel
message: 「There are no electrical parts at all... Hmm, hmm.」
Melilot-san gave a small shrug.

name: Melilot
message: 「...She isn't listening, is she.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's just that happy.」
We looked at each other and laughed.

name: Azel
message: 「Ooh! The view through the finder isn't much different from looking with the naked eye.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's because the viewfinder is close to life-size magnification.」

name: Azel
message: 「Just as the book said, the frame lines are crisp.」
It's complete gibberish to me.

name: Melilot
message: 「Here are the books explaining how to shoot and operate it.」
Acting as if she hadn't heard a word Melilot-san said, Azel took out the film she'd apparently bought in preparation for today and tried to load it into the Leica.

name: Azel
message: 「It won't go in! Where and how does this work? This is absurd.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Complaining when you don't even know how to operate it is what's absurd.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Here are the books explaining how to shoot and operate it.」
Before Melilot-san had even finished speaking, Azel was already starting the checkout process.

name: Melilot
message: 「So you can hear Synn's voice, then.」

name: Azel
message: 「It merely happened to reach my ears.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's go with that, shall we.」
The instant the checkout was done, Azel opened the book and

name: Azel
message: 「I see...... So this is how you load it......」
Immediately began wrestling with trying to put the film in.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「Mgh...... Ngh...... Like this!」
Once again, Melilot-san shrugged her shoulders.

name: Azel
message: 「Oh! Did you see that, Synn Sakura! The film is in!」
Looking up at me as she said that, Azel seemed genuinely overjoyed.
My heart skipped a beat.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I saw. I saw it.」
I found myself wanting to see Azel make faces like this more often.

name: Azel
message: 「Look, I got it in!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good for you.」

name: Azel
message: 「What shall I take a picture of first......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel. Would you take this Leica as a gift?」

name: Azel
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I won't be using it anymore, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Are you sure!?」
Melilot-san gave a small nod.

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you! I'll take good care of it!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Don't just take care of it--make sure you actually use it, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Of course!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. That's great.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah!」
Azel smiled bashfully.

name: Azel
message: 「It's all thanks to you!」
If I'd had a camera on me, I probably would have taken a picture of Azel in that moment.
Even without a photo, though, I'll never forget it for the rest of my life.
